'''The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes''' is the first act in [[Chapter II]] of the [[Main Quests|Main Quest]].

==Steps==
#Fast travel to the beacon at the [[Lighthouse of Dawn]]
# Enter [[Ragunna]] City
##Head to the Nexus
##(Optional) Follow Phoebe into the city
#Head to the [[Liberty Square]]
#Leave the Liberty Square
#Ride the Gondola to [[Averardo Bank]]
#Go to Averardo Bank
#Head to the bank counter
#Go to [[Trattoria Margherita]]
#Find a seat and sit down
#Track the Echo that lost control
#Stop the Echo that lost control
#Investigate
##Head to the Pioneer Association
##(Optional) Investigate the scene

#Go to [[Masked Reverie]]

:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_10_1.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Seek salvation from where all began... What's that supposed to mean?
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, could you elaborate?
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_10_4.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' This inscription tells the tale of Rinascita's founding. Legends speak of a group of displaced people, driven from their lands by the Lament.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_10_5.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' Though their origins were different, they followed the same ocean currents to a hidden sea.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_10_6.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' They prayed for paradise but were met with a nightmare filled with Tacet Discords. The sky darkened, the sea roared, and towering waves threatened to engulf them.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_10_7.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' At that moment, a radiant light pierced the clouds, and a voice resounded from the sky—
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_10_8.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' "Make the waters your second home, like seabirds nesting along the coast. Build your shelters hither and thither, like stars in the night sky."
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_10_9.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' "Your fortress is fragile, made only of wickers and planks, but fear not, for it is strong enough to withstand the wuthering waves."
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_10_10.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' Heeding the heavenly voice, the displaced united. A gentle breeze guided their ships, filling their sails with wind.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_10_11.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' Through the storm, they glimpsed a bright light from an unnamed island. This was the light of the Genesis Nexus.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_10_12.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' The Nexus granted them knowledge of Echoes and sent them to help build their cities. The people named the island Rinascita and built sanctuaries with inscriptions, honoring the voice that guided them to paradise.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_10_13.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' The voice did indeed reveal itself. The faithful saw the true form of their savior, who declared its sacred name—Imperator.
:{{DIcon}} A brief history lesson, please?
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_10_14.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' This inscription tells the tale of Rinascita's founding. Legends speak of a group of displaced people, driven from their lands by the Lament.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_10_15.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' Guided by the Nexus, they found refuge on this island where they learned the secrets of the Echoes and, under the Sentinel's watch, rebuilt their lives.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_10_16.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' This legend is known widely among the Ragunnesi, though the true beginnings of Rinascita remain shrouded in lost history. Scholars of the Order have never stopped their quest to uncover it.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_10_17.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Got it. Now where can we meet the Sentinel?
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_10_18.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' You wish for an audience with the Sentinel...?
:{{DIcon}} Has anyone done this before?
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_10_21.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' Yes, only one person has received such an honor—the current Primus, Fenrico.
:{{DIcon}} I heard you can talk with the Sentinel during the Carnevale.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_10_22.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' ...Yes. The Sentinel bestows the Laurel, through which the chosen one can hear Their voice. Only one has received such an honor—the current Primus, Fenrico.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_10_23.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' As the only Enlightened One in recorded history, Primus Fenrico can directly connect with the Sentinel to heed divine oracles.
:{{DIcon}} Meaning they can resonate with the Sentinel?
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_10_25.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' ...Indeed. Primus Fenrico is the Sentinel Imperator's Resonator. As such he bears the title the Enlightened One. You'll have the chance to see him at the Carnevale when he announces the opening of the ceremony.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_10_26.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' I hope you enjoy your time here in Ragunna and join in with the festivities.
:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_10_27.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' If you need help with anything, just let me know. As an Acolyte, it's my job to assist all our visitors.

:{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_11_1.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' Is there anything else you'd like to know about Ragunna? I'll do my best to answer your questions.

::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_11_6.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' Our Sentinel embodies peace, justice, modesty, and mercy. They are the lord of the sky and seas, protector of the land.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_11_7.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' They freed us from division and conflict, treating all equally and uniting us as one.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_11_8.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' Legends say the Sentinel's breath becomes a gentle breeze, blessing Ragunna's ships and guiding them safely to their destinations.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_11_9.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' Their radiant gaze pierces the darkness, illuminating the way forward. In reverence, people built lighthouses across the island.

::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_11_12.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' "I am with you, steadfast and unwavering, from the past, through the present, and beyond the future."
:{{DIcon|Option}} About the Order...
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_11_13.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' The Order of the Deep is Ragunna's de facto authority, handling everything from city management and disputes to diplomacy.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_11_14.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' We revere our Sentinel and act on Their behalf, overseeing all Common Echoes.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_11_15.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' The La Guardia, the armed Echoes you saw before you entered the city, are part of the Order, working alongside us to keep Ragunna safe and orderly.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_11_16.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' By the Sentinel's will, all citizens of Ragunna can use Common Echoes by simply registering their information with the Nexus.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_11_17.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' If you face any issues during your stay, please report them to the Order. We are here to ensure your stay is comfortable.
:{{DIcon|Option}} About the Carnevale...
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_11_18.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' The Carnevale is Rinascita's grandest annual festival, lasting seven days. Its theme is said to be "transcend the flesh to the divine realm."
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_11_19.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' The outer seas of Rinascita were once plagued by Tacet Discords and Lament occurrences, making sea travel impossible. Isolated on the island, the Ragunnesi found solace in the epics recited by limping poets and ballads sung by blind singers.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_11_20.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' Stories from many lands were shared, forming a cradle of culture and art. The people mingled, dreaming of the world beyond, envisioning a different life for themselves.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_11_21.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' These dreams came to life during the spring rite in honor of the Sentinel. People dressed in costumes, setting aside their positions and prejudices to come together for a grand parade—this is the origin of today's Carnevale.
:: {{DIcon}} Sounds fun to me.
:: {{DIcon}} Can I join it?
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_11_24.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' A stage will be set on the first day of the Carnevale. Wear a mask, and you can be part of the show.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_11_25.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' The masks set people free, allowing everyone to shed their usual roles and revel in the celebration. We haven't had a Carnevale in many years, so this one is poised to be pretty special.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_11_27.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' The streets will be alive with spectacular performances. Vendors from far and wide will showcase unique items.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_11_28.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' Even without a mask, you can still take in the atmosphere and pick up some souvenirs.
:{{DIcon|Option}} About Common Echoes...
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_11_29.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' In Rinascita, anyone can summon Common Echoes from the Nexus, whether they're a Resonator or not.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_11_30.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' It has been modified by our Sentinel to allow Echoes to appear in physical forms.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_11_31.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' However, not all Common Echoes are available for personal use. For example, La Guardia are armed guards managed exclusively by the Order.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_11_32.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' Echoes affiliated with the Order are identified by their halo and respond only to its members, so please be aware of this.
:{{DIcon|Arrow}}That's it for now.
::{{A|Vo rsmq 2_1_11_34.ogg}} '''Phoebe:''' If you have any further questions, please feel free to ask. It's our duty as Acolytes to assist every visitor.
